note: The painters' mannequins (tools/paintstage.js guides): flat grey stand-ins drawn over Zico's lettering at the crew's approved size, in the title's svg units — a standing adult 117 tall with a head of r 8 (js/crew.js: SIZE 0.42 x cap x 67/467 = 15.6), the boy 100. Nano Banana 2 was asked to turn each into a villager exactly as big as it; told the size in words it drew everyone ~1.5x (2026-09-30, three tries). Shapes: ["c", x, y, r, fill?] a disc; ["l", [[x, y], ...], width] a round-capped line; ["b", [x, y], [x, y], width, head?] a brush from hand to tip, the last `head` units black bristle; ["e", x, y, rx, ry, fill] an ellipse; ["p", d, fill] a path.
